items.title: The Centre dismisses 'fake' claims on free laptop scheme
items.snippet_en: PIB Fact Check confirmed the Government of India has not announced any free laptop scheme for students, dismissing viral messages as fake phishing scams.

items.title: The Centre dismisses 'fake' claims on free laptop scheme
items.snippet_en: PIB clarified that the government has not invited applications under any free laptop scheme, confirming circulating application details are fake.

items.title: The Centre dismisses 'fake' claims on free laptop scheme
items.snippet_en: The government warned that links circulating on social media promising free laptops are phishing scams intended to harvest personal and banking details.

items.title: Awareness Regarding Fake News of Pradhanmantri Free Laptop Scheme
items.snippet_en: AICTE issued a circular warning that claims of a 'Pradhanmantri Free Laptop Scheme' run by the Government of India are fake, as no such central scheme exists.

items.publisher: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
items.title: Awareness Regarding Fake News of Pradhanmantri Free Laptop Scheme
items.snippet_en: AICTE warned students and institutions against fraudulent registration portals circulating online in connection with the fake scheme.

items.title: 'Fake': PIB Fact Check debunks claims of 'National Student Laptop Scheme'
items.snippet_en: PIB confirmed that circulating WhatsApp application links for free laptops are fraudulent mechanisms designed to harvest user data.

outputs.notes_en: Government authorities including PIB and AICTE confirmed that no central 'Free Laptop Scheme' exists and designated circulating application deadlines and websites as phishing scams.
